items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Yours was a buffet, wasn't it, Melee? ... [INTERVIEWER] Oh, you lost a key, Melee? ... [INTERVIEWER] Maybe. Why don't I take this sometime, Melee, and do it up for you?

ctx.x: Well, I'm slow with it though, very slow with my own.

Yeah, but your fingers going pretty fast too. Now, that's something like the old 13 key you had then, huh? Yeah. About the same thing. This is another little hole. Yours was a buffet, wasn't it, Melee? That's right. Yeah, yours was a buffet. Yeah, yeah. Uh-huh. Never did see a 13 key buffet. Yeah.
That made me a little. Cut off, isn't it?
